name: Directory upload (webkitdirectory)
plain: Lets the person pick a whole folder; the page gets every file in it with relative paths.
meaning: One pick shares a full folder tree, often thousands of files. The site sees file names and sub folder structure, so a careless pick can expose more than expected.

access.revocation: Nothing to revoke (no permission is stored)
steps: Browser shows a folder chooser and, in Chrome, an Upload N files confirmation
Page receives all files with webkitRelativePath

limits.headline: Can access every file inside a folder you choose, in order to upload them
limits.user_action: You click Upload folder and choose one.
can: Receive every file in the folder, with its path inside the folder
cannot: Change or delete the original files
See other folders or files you did not include
Get the files again later without another pick

story.what_it_is: Lets you pick a whole folder, and the page receives every file in it with its folder paths.

marketing.name: webkitdirectory
marketing.pitch: Documents a file input option that lets a person choose a whole folder for upload.

story.for_you: You click upload, choose a folder, and the site gets all the files inside. It only gets what is in that folder, and you see a warning first.
story.for_makers: It saves time for bulk uploads like photo sets, code projects and course files. The person picks the folder, so no ongoing access is given. It still can send a lot of data at once.

use_cases.example: You drag a project folder into a cloud drive and all its files and subfolders go up in one go.
You upload a whole album of photos at once.
You upload a code project folder to a build or hosting site.
A game mod site takes a whole mod folder for review.
A student turns in a folder of project files to a class portal.
A 3D or music web tool loads a whole folder of assets.

technical_bounds: Chrome shows a confirmation Upload N files to this site before handing over the list
Includes all files in sub folders (hidden files and dot files may be included; Chrome filters OS junk like .DS_Store)
Cannot browse parents or siblings of the chosen folder; webkitRelativePath starts at the chosen folder name
No count cap; very large folders are bounded by memory and Chrome's confirmation counts them
Support: Chrome 7, Safari 11.1, Firefox 50 (webkit prefix kept)

legit_uses: Upload a photo album or code folder
abuse: Collecting more files than the person expects from a deep folder
